gen.title: Plutonium uses and spent fuel composition

cards.stem: What share of spent fuel from U.S. reactors is plutonium by weight?
cards.quote: Spent nuclear fuel from U.S. reactors contains about 1 percent plutonium by weight.
cards.hint: Recall the small share left in used fuel.

cards.stem: Which plutonium form has powered pacemaker batteries and provided heat for space missions?
cards.quote: Plutonium-238 has been used to power batteries for some heart pacemakers, as well as provide a long-lived heat source to power NASA space missions.
cards.hint: Think of the heat source for distant missions and medical devices.

cards.stem: What fuel product results from mixing the separated oxides together?
cards.quote: Once separated, plutonium oxide can be mixed with uranium oxide to produce mixed oxide or MOX fuel.
cards.hint: Consider what happens after chemical separation of spent fuel.
